sentences.japanese: 井の中の蛙、大海を知らず。
sentences.english: He that stays in the valley shall never get over the hill.

sentences.english: I can't believe you're so clueless. You're like a babe in the woods.

sentences.japanese: ついに彼は絶望の井に到着した。
sentences.english: At last, he arrived at the Well of Despair.
